description: This file defines functions and constants related to ONNX operators in the PyTorch framework, including symbolic representations, rotary embedding, and attention mechanisms for ONNX export.

methods.name: aten_decompositions
methods.description: Returns the ONNX to ATen decomposition table.

methods.name: _parse_domain_op_type
methods.description: Parses a domain and operator type from a string with format 'domain::op_type'.

methods.name: symbolic
methods.description: Creates a symbolic FX operator representing an arbitrary ONNX operator with a single output.

methods.name: symbolic_multi_out
methods.description: Creates a symbolic FX operator representing an ONNX operator with multiple outputs.

methods.name: rotary_embedding
methods.description: Implements the Rotary Embedding operation in ONNX.

methods.name: attention
methods.description: Implements the Attention operation in ONNX.
